0.name: TEXT_DUNGEONMYC1_00000_RIAN_000_000
0.description: Come, Dawon! We've a spot of game that wants for hunting.
0.translation_description: Vieni, Dawon! C'è selvaggina da cacciare.

1.name: TEXT_DUNGEONMYC1_00000_RIAN_000_050
1.description: Dawon was...defeated? So they've bark <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> bite, then.
1.translation_description: Dawon sconfitto...? Quindi sanno <hex:021A020203>anche<hex:021A020103> mordere, oltre che abbaiare.

2.name: TEXT_DUNGEONMYC1_00000_RIAN_000_051
2.description: Perhaps I'll take your measure another time. Until we meet again.
2.translation_description: Magari ti metterò alla prova un'altra volta. Alla prossima.
